name: Drihten Elreden

facts.text: Level 80, 30,000 health. Pulling him brings every 'DrihtenBaf' NPC: 25 thrawn ogre bocere in the world database. Casts Alacrity of the Heavenly Host (faster attacks).
Drihten means 'lord'; bocere 'scribe' (to verify). Elreden is unglossed here (to verify).

story:
Drihten Elreden holds the scriptorium of Krondon, where the old keepers wrote their histories at long desks under the lamps. He is lord of the bocere, the scribes, and there are two dozen of them now, ogres bent over books they cannot read, copying the shapes of letters because their lord says that is what scribes do. He is proud of them. Touch him and every desk empties at once, and the old blessing he learned from the walls, a prayer for swiftness the hall's priests once said for their champions, makes his blows fall faster.

The lord of the scribes. Drihten means lord, and Drihten Elreden is lord of the bocere, the scribes of Krondon's scriptorium, where the hall-folk wrote their histories at long desks under hanging lamps. The ghosts say the scriptorium was the hall's heart; whoever kept it kept the hall's memory. Orylle gave it to Drihten because he asked for it, and he asked for it because he liked the lamps.

His scribes. He has twenty-five scribes now, ogres bent over books they cannot read, copying the shapes of the letters because their lord says that is what scribes do, and he is proud of them as a father is proud of children who cannot do sums. Touch him and every desk empties at once. He learned one thing from the walls: an old blessing the hall's priests said over their champions, the swiftness of the heavenly host, and when he says it his blows fall faster. The scholars of Avalon would give a great deal to see his books; most of them are the hall's histories, copied over and over in a hand that understands nothing.
legend:
Count the scribes. Pull Drihten and all twenty-five come with him, so clear the room's edges first or bring enough to tank a scriptorium. When he starts swinging faster, rotate tanks. The scribes hit soft and die easy, but there are so many that the casters at the back are always the first to learn it.

Pull from the far end of the scriptorium so the scribes come to you through the desks, and keep the area damage for them. Do not loot the books; they are only copies of copies, and the scholars of Avalon will not pay for them.

loremasterTopic.text: Drihten Elreden keeps the scriptorium, a lord over two dozen ogre scribes. Strike him and every desk empties. Count them before you start.

bookPage: The scriptorium of Krondon is the most terrible room I have stood in, and nothing in it tried to kill me until we touched its lord. Twenty-five ogres sat at the long desks under the lamps, copying. I looked over one shoulder. He was copying a history of the hall, letter by letter, and he had been copying it so long that the page was nearly worn through, and he did not know what any word meant. Drihten Elreden watched them as a father watches his children. When we struck him, every pen went down at once. I took one book. It is in my satchel. I cannot bear to open it.
